heroHeadline: I help organisations figure out what's next.
heroSubtext: I work with CEOs and leadership teams to understand complex problems, design the right response, build the systems and teams required, and scale what works.
heroImageAlt: Portrait of Parul Soni Manvati — [CONTENT NEEDED: replace with a real photograph]
credibilityHeading: A career across technology, operations, transformation and emerging businesses.
methodSubheading: Complex problems rarely arrive neatly defined. The work starts before the solution.

methodStages.title: Figure Out
methodStages.detail: Research, diagnose, listen, validate. Identify the root problem before reaching for a solution.

methodStages.title: Design
methodStages.short: Build the strategy and operating model.
methodStages.detail: Strategy, operating model, organisation, process, technology, KPIs and governance — structured into a coherent response.

methodStages.title: Build
methodStages.short: Turn plans into systems, teams and products.
methodStages.detail: Teams, products, departments, systems, processes and partnerships — the design made real.

methodStages.title: Scale
methodStages.detail: People, capital, technology, process, go-to-market and governance — built for operating leverage.

methodStages.title: Transform
methodStages.short: Prepare the organisation for what comes next.
methodStages.detail: Business, organisation, technology, customer experience, operating model and policy — readied for the next stage.

experienceSubheading: A career is more useful when you can see the problems behind the titles.
aboutText: I'm most effective when the problem is complex, the answer isn't obvious, different stakeholders see it differently, the organisation needs structure, and someone needs to figure out what comes next.
thinkingSubheading: Notes on strategy, transformation, technology, organisations, scaling and the problems leaders don't always have time to think through.
advisoryHeading: When the problem is bigger than a meeting.
advisoryText: I work selectively with founders, CEOs, leadership teams and organisations navigating important transitions — from defining what needs to change to designing and building what comes next.
speakingText: Parul speaks on strategy, transformation, technology, scaling, emerging businesses, leadership and building organisations for what comes next.
impactText: Building institutions and communities, not only businesses — including work with ABWCI / Women in Supply Chain.
finalCtaHeading: Have a difficult problem to think through?
finalCtaText: I'm always interested in thoughtful conversations around organisations, transformation, technology, emerging businesses and what comes next.
